overview.positioning: The definitive 6-month, 240-hour career program for building, operating, and scaling professional online stores using Shopify and WooCommerce without writing code.
overview.short_description: Master Shopify OS 2.0 and WooCommerce 9.x to architect, design, and launch commercial e-commerce stores with payment gateways, statutory Indian GST compliance, Shiprocket fulfillment, and retention automation.

what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Independently configure, design, and publish production-grade storefronts on both Shopify (OS 2.0) and WooCommerce (9.x).
Engineer structured multi-category product catalogs with multi-dimensional variants, automated collections, and bulk CSV migrations.
Integrate eligible Indian payment gateways (Razorpay, Cashfree) in test/sandbox modes and configure Cash on Delivery (COD) with OTP fraud verification.
Configure statutory Indian GST tax rules (intra-state CGST/SGST vs inter-state IGST) with automated legal B2B PDF tax invoicing.
Automate multi-courier shipping with Shiprocket, generate AWB shipping labels, and build branded customer order tracking pages.
Deploy automated customer retention funnels in Klaviyo, event-driven operational rules in Shopify Flow, and cross-platform webhooks via Make/n8n.
Leverage generative AI for prompt-driven catalog copywriting, studio product packshot staging, and customer service reply templates.
Deliver professional client handoff assets: 15-minute Loom video training walkthroughs and comprehensive Merchant Operating Manuals.

why_now.industry_shift: The explosive growth of D2C brands in India and globally has created an urgent demand for store builders who can implement robust transactional websites without prolonged, expensive software development cycles.
why_now.ai_impact: Native e-commerce AI (Shopify Magic) and visual generative AI tools now empower no-code specialists to produce commercial studio packshots and optimized product copy at 10x velocity.
why_now.business_demand: Merchants desperately require operational specialists who understand payment gateway settlement, GST invoicing compliance, COD fraud prevention, and automated shipping logistics beyond basic visual aesthetics.
why_now.career_opportunity: E-commerce store implementation specialists command premium domestic salaries (₹4.5L–₹10.5L LPA) and freelance agency project fees (₹35,000–₹1,50,000 per build) due to direct revenue generation.

learning_outcomes: STORE ARCHITECTURE & SETUP: Independently configure Shopify OS 2.0 and WooCommerce 9.x environments with custom domain routing, SSL security, and merchant administrative parameters.
CATALOG & INVENTORY ENGINEERING: Structure multi-dimensional variant matrices, manage inventory thresholds, execute bulk CSV migrations, and standardize product attributes using AI.
HIGH-CONVERTING STOREFRONT UX: Design responsive, mobile-first storefronts utilizing modular sections, custom block templates, sticky cart controls, and Baymard CRO principles.

TRANSACTIONAL CHECKOUT & COMPLIANCE: Configure supported payment gateways (Razorpay/Cashfree), manage COD with OTP verification, and implement statutory Indian GST rate matrices with automated B2B invoicing.
LOGISTICS & FULFILLMENT AUTOMATION: Integrate multi-courier shipping with Shiprocket, generate AWB labels, construct branded tracking pages, and automate reverse returns to prevent RTO losses.
RETENTION & NO-CODE WORKFLOWS: Build automated customer lifecycle flows in Klaviyo, trigger operational rules via Shopify Flow, and synchronize cross-platform data with Make/n8n.
ANALYTICS & CLIENT HANDOFF: Verify GA4 enhanced e-commerce datalayer events, syndicate error-free Google Merchant Center feeds, and produce comprehensive client training runbooks.

faq.question: Do I need prior coding, programming, or web development experience to enroll?
faq.answer: No. E-Commerce Website Mastery is engineered from the ground up for beginners, freelancers, and career switchers. The entire 240-hour curriculum focuses on visual, no-code store architecture, theme customization, and operational software integration (Shopify OS 2.0, WordPress Block Editor, WooCommerce). No prior knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or PHP is required. Standard digital literacy, web browsing familiarity, and comfort with digital spreadsheets are the only prerequisites.

faq.question: Why does the curriculum teach both Shopify and WooCommerce instead of just one?
faq.answer: Shopify and WooCommerce together power over 85% of independent e-commerce storefronts globally. Shopify is the premier enterprise SaaS platform chosen by fast-growing D2C brands for its hosting simplicity, high-concurrency checkout, and rapid deployment. WooCommerce is the leading open-source commerce solution, ideal for merchants demanding 100% data ownership, zero recurring GMV transaction fees, deep WordPress content integration, and limitless customization. Mastering both makes you uniquely versatile and doubles your freelance and employment opportunities.

faq.question: Which payment gateways are taught and how do they work in labs?

faq.question: What are the payment gateway realities and merchant limitations for Shopify in India?
faq.answer: Students are explicitly taught real-world regulatory realities: Shopify Payments is not natively available for Indian domestic merchants without international business entities. Therefore, Indian Shopify stores must integrate registered third-party payment gateways like Razorpay or Cashfree. Furthermore, live commercial merchant accounts strictly require registered business documentation (GSTIN, PAN, active business current bank account, KYC). For training purposes, students build and test everything within official, fully functional developer sandbox accounts that require zero commercial business documentation.

faq.question: How are order tracking, delivery notifications, and customer returns implemented?

You will configure automated multichannel customer notifications across the order lifecycle (Order Confirmed, Dispatched, Out for Delivery, Delivered) via email and SMS webhooks. Additionally, you will build self-service customer return/exchange request workflows, configure reverse pickup dispatch, and implement Return-to-Origin (RTO) mitigation protocols.

faq.question: How is statutory Indian GST tax compliance configured?
faq.answer: The curriculum provides comprehensive, practical training on statutory Indian Goods and Services Tax (GST) rules for retail commerce. You will configure CGST + SGST (intra-state sales) versus IGST (inter-state sales), assign HSN codes to product categories, configure tax-inclusive consumer pricing alongside tax-exclusive B2B catalog views, and automate legal tax invoice generation containing merchant GSTIN, buyer GSTIN, SAC/HSN summaries, and consecutive tax invoice series numbers.

subtopics: WordPress ecosystem: Core software, themes, plugins, and database relationship architecture
Setting up LocalWP: configuring local domains (.local), PHP version switching (8.2/8.3), and One-Click Admin login
Server prerequisites: memory_limit, max_execution_time, upload_max_filesize, and Redis/LiteSpeed object caching concepts
Permalinks and URL structuring for optimal e-commerce SEO indexing
User role hierarchy and security: Shop Manager vs Administrator access limitations

lessons.lesson_title: WooCommerce 9.x Core Setup, HPOS & Product Architecture

subtopics: WooCommerce 9.x setup wizard: configuring store location, currency formatting, and measurement units
High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS): dedicated order tables (wc_orders) for massive performance and scalability
Product type engineering: Simple physical goods, downloadable digital files, and complex Variable items
Custom attributes vs global taxonomy attributes (Size, Color, Material) and variation swatches

lessons.lesson_title: WordPress Block Editor, Site Editor & WooCommerce Templates

lessons.lesson_title: Cart & Checkout Blocks, Account Portals & Order Lifecycle

lessons.lesson_title: Visual Page Building with Elementor & Responsive Store Customization

WooCommerce dynamic tags and template widgets in visual builders
Designing a high-converting single-product promotional micro-landing page with sticky purchase trigger

lessons.lesson_title: Plugin Compatibility, Security, Disaster Recovery & Staging-to-Production

lessons.expected_outcome: A hardened, secure WooCommerce store with a restorable backup archive and verified migration procedure.
lessons.example: Using UpdraftPlus to take an encrypted database snapshot before performing core WooCommerce major version updates.

lessons.lesson_title: The E-Commerce Customer Journey & Discovery UX
lessons.what_is_taught: Anatomy of the customer buying journey: awareness, exploration, product consideration, commitment, and checkout; cognitive load reduction on homepages and collection pages; intuitive category discovery, faceted search filters, breadcrumb navigation, and zero-search-result failover recovery.
subtopics: Mapping user cognitive stages: Browsers vs Searchers vs Discount Hunters
Homepage visual hierarchy: hero value proposition, quick-access category shortcuts, and social proof anchors
Category and collection browsing UX: sticky filter sidebars, multi-attribute facet selection, and dynamic product count counters
Predictive search design: instant autocomplete, thumbnail previews, typo tolerance, and suggested trending queries
Designing zero-results pages: offering helpful collection links and top-selling recommendations instead of dead ends

Interactive size guides and specification tables to drastically reduce return rates

Reassurance trust icons: 30-day money-back guarantee, secure checkout, and official brand warranty callouts

lessons.lesson_title: Mobile Cart Usability, Frictionless Navigation & Ethical Scarcity

Gamified progress incentives: dynamic free-shipping progress bar (e.g., 'Add ₹150 more to unlock FREE Delivery')
In-cart cross-sells and order bumps: one-click add-ons (warranty, sample packs, complementary items)
Pricing transparency: displaying inclusive GST taxes and estimated shipping upfront to prevent checkout abandonment
Ethical CRO: rejecting fake countdown timers, fabricated '3 people viewing this' alerts, and misleading strikethrough prices

A/B testing methodology: formulating data-backed hypotheses, defining success metrics, and avoiding testing with insufficient traffic
Conducting before-and-after conversion audits on a training storefront
lessons.why_it_matters: Data-driven UX audits allow agencies to charge ₹35,000–₹75,000 for standalone CRO consulting retainers backed by session evidence.
lessons.what_learner_does: Integrates Microsoft Clarity, performs a comprehensive 40-point usability audit on a sample store, and produces a prioritized before/after optimization report.
lessons.expected_outcome: A professional E-Commerce UX & CRO Audit Dossier containing heatmap analysis, identified friction points, and implemented fixes.

modules.assessment_criteria: Complete UX audit documentation demonstrating measurable friction reductions, verified mobile responsiveness, and ethical CRO compliance.

lessons.lesson_title: Checkout Architecture, Customer Data & Platform Boundaries
lessons.what_is_taught: Checkout journey architecture: Customer Information, Shipping Address, Shipping Method, and Payment; guest checkout vs account-mandatory models; address autocomplete; field optimization; platform checkout constraints (Shopify checkout restrictions on non-Plus plans vs open WooCommerce checkout customization); checkout failure recovery workflows.
subtopics: Anatomy of modern checkouts: Single-page checkout vs 3-step checkout funnels
Guest checkout vs mandatory customer account creation: impact on checkout abandonment rates
Form field optimization: removing non-essential fields, setting phone number as primary identifier, and postal code auto-fill
Understanding Shopify checkout plan boundaries: checkout branding and app blocks on Basic/Shopify plans vs Checkout Extensibility
WooCommerce checkout freedom: customizing checkout fields using filters and Checkout Blocks without core modification
Abandoned checkout recovery: automated recovery email sequences and SMS notification triggers
lessons.why_it_matters: Checkout is the most financially sensitive stage of an online store; excessive fields or confusing navigation causes up to 70% of potential buyers to abandon.
lessons.what_learner_does: Configures optimized checkout settings on both platforms: enables guest checkout, sets phone number validation, and tests abandoned checkout recovery.
lessons.expected_outcome: A streamlined, frictionless checkout process capturing essential customer and address data with zero redundant fields.
lessons.example: Enabling 1-page checkout on Shopify with address autocomplete to reduce mobile checkout completion time by 40%.

lessons.lesson_title: Indian Payment Gateway Integration & Sandbox Transaction Testing
lessons.what_is_taught: Indian e-commerce payment gateway landscape: Razorpay, Cashfree, and PayU; reality of Shopify Payments (not available natively for Indian domestic entities; third-party gateway requirement); gateway setup: creating free developer sandbox accounts, API Key ID and Key Secret configuration; webhook listeners; simulating UPI, card, and NetBanking test transactions.
subtopics: Payment ecosystem analysis: Payment Aggregators (Razorpay, Cashfree) vs Payment Gateways vs Merchant Banks
Shopify in India reality: configuring approved third-party payment providers (Razorpay Payment Gateway, Cashfree) without Shopify Payments
Setting up Razorpay and Cashfree Developer Sandbox accounts with simulated test modes
Installing and configuring payment plugins: WooCommerce Razorpay plugin and Shopify Third-Party Provider setup
Executing test transactions using standard sandbox credentials: UPI success/failure strings, test credit cards (success, 3DS OTP, declined, insufficient funds)
Payment settlement concepts: Authorization vs Auto-Capture, T+2 settlement cycles, rolling reserves, and simulated full/partial refunds
lessons.why_it_matters: Improper payment gateway configuration results in declined transactions, lost revenue, and delayed settlement payouts.
lessons.what_learner_does: Connects Razorpay sandbox to both Shopify and WooCommerce staging stores, runs 5 test transactions (UPI, card success, card decline), and verifies order status transitions.
lessons.expected_outcome: Verified payment gateway integration processing simulated UPI and card payments with correct order confirmation status.
lessons.example: Simulating a successful UPI transaction in Razorpay sandbox using `success@razorpay` virtual payment address.

lessons.lesson_title: Cash on Delivery (COD) Operations & Fraud Risk Mitigation
lessons.what_is_taught: Cash on Delivery (COD) mechanics in India (accounting for 50%+ of orders in Tier 2/3 cities); financial reality of Return to Origin (RTO) shipping penalties; configuring COD payment methods; implementing COD order confirmation via phone OTP verification; setting COD fee surcharges; defining maximum COD order value thresholds.
subtopics: The economics of COD in Indian retail: why customers demand it and how RTO courier costs erode profitability
Configuring native Cash on Delivery in WooCommerce and Shopify with custom checkout instructions
Implementing phone OTP verification: verifying customer mobile numbers before confirming COD orders to prevent bogus purchases
Configuring COD surcharge fees (e.g. ₹50 extra for COD orders) to incentivize prepaid UPI payments
Restricting COD availability: setting minimum/maximum order value limits (e.g. no COD above ₹5,000) and disabling COD for high-RTO postal pincodes
lessons.why_it_matters: Unverified COD orders result in 20%–35% RTO rates in Indian e-commerce; automated OTP verification cuts fake orders by over 60%.
lessons.what_learner_does: Configures Cash on Delivery with an automated OTP verification step and ₹50 convenience fee surcharge on a staging storefront.
lessons.expected_outcome: A functional COD payment pipeline protected by automated phone verification and clear customer delivery terms.
lessons.example: Triggering a 4-digit OTP SMS verification modal when a customer selects Cash on Delivery at checkout.

lessons.lesson_title: Indian Statutory GST Tax Engine & Automated Invoicing Compliance
lessons.what_is_taught: Statutory Indian Goods and Services Tax (GST) principles for e-commerce; tax-inclusive vs tax-exclusive retail pricing; configuring GST tax rates (0%, 5%, 12%, 18%, 28%); Intra-state supply (CGST + SGST split) vs Inter-state supply (IGST); HSN/SAC code mapping per product category; collecting customer GSTIN at checkout for B2B input tax credit; generating legal tax invoices.
subtopics: Indian GST compliance framework: CGST (Central), SGST (State), and IGST (Integrated) tax distribution rules
Tax-inclusive pricing standards in consumer retail: ensuring prices shown on storefront include all applicable taxes
Configuring WooCommerce tax tables and Shopify tax settings based on merchant shipping origin state
Harmonized System of Nomenclature (HSN) codes: assigning mandatory 4-digit and 6-digit HSN codes to product catalogs
B2B GSTIN collection: adding customer GST number and company name fields to checkout with format regex validation
Automating legal PDF GST tax invoices: generating invoices displaying merchant GSTIN, customer GSTIN, tax breakdown table, and signature block
lessons.why_it_matters: Incorrect GST calculation or non-compliant invoicing leads to severe tax penalties, commercial disputes, and loss of B2B corporate customers.
lessons.what_learner_does: Configures a complete Indian GST tax matrix with 5%, 12%, and 18% rates, runs test checkouts from intra-state and inter-state addresses, and inspects the generated PDF tax invoice.
lessons.expected_outcome: A fully verified statutory GST tax engine accurately splitting CGST/SGST or applying IGST with compliant automated B2B invoices.
lessons.example: Verifying that a customer in Maharashtra buying from a Mumbai store gets charged 9% CGST + 9% SGST, while a customer in Delhi gets charged 18% IGST.

lessons.lesson_title: Payment Security, Credential Safety, MFA & End-to-End Checkout QA
lessons.what_is_taught: E-Commerce transaction security standards: HTTPS/SSL encryption, PCI-DSS compliance scope for merchants; secure credential handling (never sharing live API keys or storing customer credit card data); admin multi-factor authentication (MFA); webhook signature verification; end-to-end checkout quality assurance (QA) protocol.
subtopics: PCI-DSS compliance: why merchants use hosted payment gateways to avoid touching raw credit card numbers
Secure API key management: separating test keys from live production keys and storing secrets safely
Enforcing Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) on all Shopify, WordPress, and Payment Gateway admin accounts
Webhook signature validation: verifying that incoming order paid webhooks originate from the authentic payment gateway server
Comprehensive 25-Point Checkout QA Checklist: testing discount codes, tax splits, address edge cases, mobile wallets, and refund flows
Emergency payment failure procedures: diagnosing gateway downtime and configuring temporary failover payment methods
lessons.why_it_matters: A single compromised credential or broken checkout integration destroys merchant reputation and risks catastrophic financial liability.
lessons.what_learner_does: Conducts a 25-point checkout security and transaction QA audit across both training storefronts, simulating edge cases and verifying webhook signatures.
lessons.expected_outcome: A signed Checkout & Payment Integration QA Audit Report confirming secure, compliant transaction processing across all payment modes.

lessons.lesson_title: Commercial AI Ethics, Rights Governance & Human-in-the-Loop Quality Control

Data privacy guardrails: masking customer names, credit card info, and sensitive merchant financials before prompting external LLMs
The Human-in-the-Loop Verification Protocol: mandatory 4-step checklist (Accuracy, Brand Voice, Legal Compliance, Formatting) before publishing
AI cost monitoring: tracking token expenditure and credit limits across Canva, Adobe Firefly, and LLM API services
lessons.why_it_matters: Publishing hallucinated product claims or fake reviews exposes merchants to lawsuits, account bans, and irreversible loss of consumer trust.
lessons.what_learner_does: Conducts a comprehensive Responsible AI Audit on all generated copy and visual assets, documenting verified human edits and compliance sign-offs.

lessons.lesson_title: Comprehensive Store Acceptance Testing & Cross-Device QA
lessons.what_is_taught: Master 100-Point Pre-Launch Quality Assurance (QA) framework; heuristic store acceptance testing: checking header/footer links, broken image links, product variant price updates, inventory thresholds, and tax calculations; cross-browser and cross-device testing across iOS Safari, Android Chrome, desktop Chrome, Safari, and Firefox; testing cart and checkout edge cases: coupon stacking, zero-value orders, address validation errors, and simulated payment declines.
subtopics: The 100-Point Pre-Launch QA Checklist: Systematic auditing across 6 operational domains (Catalog, UI/UX, Checkout, Tax/Legal, Shipping, Tracking)
Device and browser rendering: testing viewport breakpoints (360px, 390px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px) and fixing mobile overflow scrollbugs
Edge-case testing: testing invalid postal codes, out-of-stock size attempts, minimum order quantity limits, and coupon expiry restrictions
Checking transactional email dispatches: verifying order confirmation, shipping update, and customer account emails render properly on Gmail and Apple Mail
Broken link scanning: using link checkers to eliminate 404 errors across navigation menus, collection links, and policy footers
lessons.why_it_matters: Launching with broken checkout buttons, distorted mobile images, or non-functional links destroys ad spend and permanently damages brand credibility.
lessons.what_learner_does: Conducts a full 100-point pre-launch QA audit on a development store, documents 8 identified defects, applies fixes, and validates retest evidence.
lessons.expected_outcome: A completed 100-Point Pre-Launch QA Scorecard and Defect Resolution Log with 100% test pass status across all critical paths.
lessons.example: Catching a mobile layout bug where a sticky Add to Cart bar obscured the postal code input field on 375px iPhone screens.

lessons.lesson_title: Core Web Vitals Optimization, Image Compression & App/Plugin Auditing
lessons.what_is_taught: Technical performance optimization: auditing store speed using Google PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, and GTmetrix; optimizing Core Web Vitals: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP < 2.5s), Interaction to Next Paint (INP < 200ms), and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS < 0.1); batch image compression to WebP/AVIF; auditing third-party Shopify apps and WooCommerce plugins to identify and remove script bloat; CSS and JavaScript deferral.
subtopics: Understanding Core Web Vitals thresholds and their direct impact on e-commerce mobile conversion and Google search rankings
Image optimization protocol: batch resizing, modern WebP compression (<150KB per product image), and lazy-loading below-the-fold media
Shopify app auditing: identifying heavy tracking scripts, chat widgets, and review apps that inject unoptimized JavaScript payloads
WooCommerce performance tuning: eliminating unused plugin scripts from checkout pages and configuring page caching
Eliminating layout shifts (CLS): reserving explicit aspect-ratio container dimensions for hero banners and product image grids
lessons.why_it_matters: A 1-second improvement in mobile store load speed increases conversion rates by up to 27%; speed is a primary commercial differentiator.
lessons.what_learner_does: Audits a sluggish store, compresses all image assets, removes unneeded app scripts, and boosts the mobile PageSpeed score from below 50 to 85+.
lessons.expected_outcome: Before-and-after Google PageSpeed Insights and Lighthouse performance audit reports demonstrating verified speed improvements.
lessons.example: Deferring a third-party live chat widget to load 3 seconds after page render, reducing initial page weight by 450KB.

lessons.lesson_title: Store Security Hardening, Multi-Factor Authentication & Disaster Recovery
lessons.what_is_taught: E-Commerce security architecture: enforcing HTTPS/SSL across all storefront pages; merchant credential security: enforcing Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) across store admin, domain registrar, and payment gateway portals; staff account role delegation (limiting access based on job function); WordPress security hardening: brute-force login throttling, XML-RPC protection; automated cloud disaster recovery backups using UpdraftPlus to Google Drive / AWS S3; emergency store restoration drill.
subtopics: SSL/TLS protocol verification: ensuring mixed-content warnings are eliminated and HTTPS redirects are forced site-wide
Access control governance: removing inactive staff accounts, enforcing 2FA for all administrators, and using collaborator accounts for agency access
WordPress security hardening: changing database table prefixes, protecting wp-config.php, and installing security scanners
Disaster recovery planning: configuring automated daily database backups and weekly full-file backups to independent cloud storage
Emergency recovery drill: simulating catastrophic database corruption and performing a complete 1-click restoration within 15 minutes
lessons.why_it_matters: Stores face constant automated credential-stuffing and hacking attempts; robust security and verified backups prevent business bankruptcy.
lessons.what_learner_does: Hardens admin security, configures automated daily cloud backups, and executes a full simulated emergency store restoration test.
lessons.expected_outcome: A verified Disaster Recovery & Security Hardening Protocol with a successfully restored test backup archive.
lessons.example: Restoring a corrupted WooCommerce database from an UpdraftPlus Google Drive backup in under 10 minutes with zero data loss.

lessons.lesson_title: Platform Migration Governance, SEO Redirect Preservation & Go-Live Checklist
lessons.what_is_taught: E-Commerce replatforming and migration fundamentals: migrating from legacy platforms (WooCommerce to Shopify or vice versa); exporting and transforming customer, order, and product data; 301 redirect mapping: crawling legacy URLs and mapping old product/collection paths to new store URLs to preserve existing Google rankings; pre-launch DNS cutover procedures (pointing A and CNAME records); post-launch smoke testing; client launch sign-off protocol.
subtopics: Replatforming scope: data mapping differences between Shopify and WooCommerce database schemas
Extracting legacy URL structures using Screaming Frog and creating a 1:1 redirect mapping spreadsheet
Implementing 301 permanent redirects in Shopify and WordPress to prevent 404 errors and preserve backlink equity
The Go-Live Cutover Protocol: lowering DNS TTL (Time To Live), updating root A records, pointing CNAME records, and activating SSL
Post-launch smoke test: placing a real ₹10 UPI payment on live production, verifying order confirmation, and initiating immediate test refund
Formal client launch sign-off: delivering the completed Pre-Launch Acceptance Certificate
lessons.why_it_matters: A botched replatforming without 301 redirects can obliterate 50%–80% of a merchant's organic Google search traffic overnight.
lessons.what_learner_does: Creates a 301 redirect map for 25 legacy store URLs, executes the migration import, and conducts a post-launch live transaction smoke test.
lessons.expected_outcome: A complete 301 Redirect Map spreadsheet and a signed Client Launch Sign-off Certificate with verified live smoke test evidence.
lessons.example: Mapping legacy URL `/product-category/skin-care/serums/rosehip-oil` to new URL `/products/rosehip-serum` via permanent 301 redirect.
